$comment: Issue labels, applied by tools/sync-github.js (the repo-sync workflow). `from` renames an existing label instead of creating a second one. Labels not listed here are left alone.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something does not work as documented

labels.name: feature
labels.description: A new capability or a change in behaviour

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Docs, guides and comments

labels.name: security
labels.description: A vulnerability or a hardening change (see SECURITY.md)

labels.name: good first issue

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: The maintainer would welcome a pull request

labels.name: needs maintainer decision

labels.name: question

labels.name: duplicate
